side.guard_dog.speaker: Guard Dog
side.guard_dog.text: Woof. (One thump of the tail, as if to say: gold first.)

side.training_need_weapon.speaker: Narration
side.training_need_weapon.text: Old footprints still mark the sand of the training platform. Go have Ding raise your sword before you train.

side.training_daily_cap.speaker: System
side.training_daily_cap.text: You've hit today's training limit. Go get some air in the field or a hunting ground.

side.training_result.speaker: System
side.training_result.text: Your power is now {power}. Take the materials to Ding, or sell them to Amber.

side.weapon_rack_untasked.speaker: Narration
side.weapon_rack_untasked.text: The rack is more than half empty. A broken sword lies half-buried in the sand — a very old edge.

side.broken_blade_gone.speaker: Narration
side.broken_blade_gone.text: There's nothing left here that Ding wants.

side.amber_has_letter.speaker: Amber
side.amber_has_letter.text: Oh? That letter in your hand… the Veilfog seal? Give it to the captain. I take gold, not other people's troubles.

side.amber_has_letter.speaker: Amber
side.amber_has_letter.text: Shop's open as usual. Forging stock and red water, both in.

side.amber_shop_open.speaker: Amber
side.amber_shop_open.text: Materials shop, open. Scrap iron, star sand, oak resin, knight shards — I buy what drops and sell what you're short of.

side.amber_shop_open.speaker: Amber
side.amber_shop_open.text: Learn to run the numbers: go fight, sell me the drops, forge with the gold; buy from me when you're short and head out again. Even a rabbit keeps books.

side.ronin_guard_fire.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_guard_fire.text: I watch the fire here. Whoever goes up… don't do what I did and burn the flame like firewood.

side.ronin_guard_fire.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_guard_fire.text: If you fall, I'll drag you back. Once.

side.ronin_gone.speaker: Narration
side.ronin_gone.text: Only scorched bootprints are left on the ground. The ronin is gone.

side.ronin_too_early.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_too_early.text: …Too early. Go fight your lion first.

side.ronin_defeated.speaker: Black Flame Ronin
side.ronin_defeated.text: …Strong… and what of it… the flame is still empty…

side.ronin_defeated.speaker: System
side.ronin_defeated.text: Defeated the Black Flame Ronin. 55 gold · 3 stardust · {xp} exp{level_up}. Where he fell, the bootprints no longer burn.

side.ding_debt_remind.speaker: Ding
side.ding_debt_remind.text: The broken sword is still in the training yard. Don't waste my breath.
